description: This file contains functions for masking and unmasking specific patterns within markdown-like text, primarily used for processing documentation placeholders, code snippets, and URLs.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks code snippets, links, and URLs in the input text, replacing them with placeholders.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Helper function that replaces matches of a regex in text with placeholders, updating the mapping and placeholders list.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Specialized function for masking URLs within link syntax in the text.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in text with their original content using the mapping.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Checks that all placeholders are present in the text.
